spec.scene: A warm patch of green lawn bathed in soft golden sunlight. At the back, a leafy lemon tree branches outward, dotted with yellow lemons and casting gentle dappled shade. In the center, an elderly cream-colored small dog rests peacefully curled up on a soft woven blanket. Two small figures in muted sweaters sit gently on the blanket beside her. A few fallen yellow lemons rest quietly in the grass near the front edge, glowing warmly in the afternoon light.
spec.title: Under the Lemon Tree
spec.caption: We sat with Mochi in her favorite sunny spot.
